status: retrospective existing-production reobservation; specified before the K-stratified thermal/source aggregate, not before original target reveal
source: S=(CB+CW)/N, the same p-independent raw absolute-cluster source; no fitted counterterms
new_statistics: Each aligned batch and orientation retains every K=0..N row: count, sum q, sum E, sum unscaled cluster count s, sum q*s, sum E*s
change_of_measure: w_K(p)=(p/p_ref)^K*((1-p)/(1-p_ref))^(N-K); self-normalized importance means and analytic first/second derivatives include the normalization denominator
estimator_boundary: Same canonical expectation and original U definition, estimated from finite fixed-p importance samples rather than the original conditional threshold integrals; do not substitute empirical K frequencies with a truncated exact-binomial distribution
root: Pooled mean q=0 for each N, refound inside every aligned delete-one
U: N^(13/8)*P4_standard[partial_p mean E]/(2*mean partial_p q), evaluated at the pooled root
primary: U_dot for the common raw cluster source, including direct thermal/source, root-motion, source-slope and root-slope terms
source_derivatives: JE_p=partial_p Cov(E,S), Jq_p=partial_p Cov(q,S); K stratification provides the required mixed cumulants without finite differences
covariance: 100 equal-size aligned batches per N; delete same batch in both geometries, refind root and recalculate all terms; full covariance and delete-one vectors saved
joint_zero: One nominal two-N U_dot zero summary under the ordinary N-separated PRNG-domain assumption; component allocations are not independent tests
not_scoreable: If the root is not bracketed or any retained central/delete-one effective sample size is below the declared floor, label that size unscoreable; do not change p or replace missing definitions
remaining_scope: Only N65/N85 parents. Full original residuals need 65-130-260 and85-170-340 with the same source definition and a mechanism-specific source-deformation prediction. No automatic q2/Jordan law for arbitrary lambda.
resources: One local CPU reobservation per N, zero new random counters or probability-point production, no server/GPU/test suite
report_shape: Repository technical narrative: actual result, original observable and estimator, source/root/slope decomposition, paired uncertainty and finite-importance scope, next physical prediction; two parent sizes do not support an asymptotic scaling plot.
